text: Chaar log...\naur sirf ek ki\nkahani adhoori!
Clue isi video\nmein hai.\nDhyaan se dekhna!
Sneha apne kamre\nmein bistar par\nMARI MILI!
Farsh par ghadi ke\nkaanch ke tukde\nbikhre the!
Par Sneha ki apni\nghadi bilkul\nsahi-salaamat thi
CHHOTI BEHEN\n"Main abhi hostel\nse aayi hoon"
PADOSI VERMA JI\n"Poori raat ek\nshaadi mein tha"
"Hafte bhar se Sneha\nse mila hi nahi"
Shivam ki nazar se\nkoi nahi bachta.
